notes.title: 2021-12-06 Update Note
notes.notes:
2021-12-06 Update has been released.

The update includes:

 A bug regarding the 'skip playback video' feature has been fixed:
- You can skip playback videos by using 'Ctrl' button. 
- 'ESC' button is no longer used for this feature.

notes.title: 2021-12-03 Update Note
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310500/807d2fefb6d2b5825b6890ee5411ead38562cd76.png
2021-12-03 Update has been released.

The update includes:


Keyboard: The key for the "Fast-Forward" feature on the keyboard has been changed from 'ESC' to 'Ctrl'. 

 DualShock4®: Fixed a bug regarding an error when opening the quick save menu with touch-pad. Now, you can open the quick save menu by using the 'SHARE' button.

BURIED STARS is now available on Steam!

notes.title: BURIED STARS Steam Global Release Announcement
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41310500/64bc764f733dc64d9aed2f8c1f05fa7e33811fa4.png
BURIED STARS is finally coming on-air on Steam!
​
Buried Stars is a mystery adventure game presented by Studio Largo, launched on PlayStation® 4/VITA and NINTENDO SWITCH™ on July 30th, 2020.
At last, we are excited to tell you that it will be available for PC on Steam!
​
We will announce the release date very soon, and you can check our Steam store page and add it to your wishlist to get notified.​
​​
We are looking forward to meeting you all soon!
